description: The canister comes down the tube at a slant and stops with a bang that is not entirely its own fault. Pip's note reads: "The rack the tubes run through is held up by string and goodwill, and the goodwill has gone home. If you have bent nails, ten tins would, well. Ten tins. I can pay in pork. Everybody is paid in pork this month. Pip."

options.label: Send ten tins of bent nails up the tube, and accept the pork.

success.text: The tins go up with a sound like a dropped drawer of cutlery. By evening the rack has stopped swaying, the tubes have stopped rattling, and a parcel of salt pork arrives wrapped in a Counting-House circular. Pip's note says only: "Straight enough."

options.label: Send one tin, and a note telling Pip where the rest of Rustmoor is.

success.text: The reply comes back in under a minute: "Fair." The tube rack sways a little less, in the one corner where your tin of nails went. Pip, you suspect, will not be paying in pork for this.
